label: PROVEN-GIVEN-ASSUMPTIONS

claim.words: From the v6.3 state before frame 77808 (Heat Man capsule -> Air Man capsule walk in Wily 5), no pad sequence of length <= 3 makes ($0400 == $26 or $2C == $0B) true after a frame; a sequence of length 4 does, i.e. the capsule is touched at the end of frame 77811 at the earliest, as in v6.3. It says nothing about the frames before 77808.

assumption_notes: Register ids of docs/proof-standards.md section 6. A-HARNESS applies to every emulator-based claim. A-TAINT is listed because the closure over all 256 pads was checked only on sampled entries; checking it on every entry (pfcheck.py without --classes, or pfcheck_stream.py --all256) removes it. A-CORE-EQ: not yet checked on the judge core.

root.rebuild: power-on in a fresh process, then pads 0..77807 of the movie, one continuous replay
root.note: The certificate's own root.how / root.state_sha256 / core.search_lib record how the search was started before packaging (from a pickled savestate; core.search_lib is the path of the analysis library on the machine that ran it). They are provenance only; the checkers ignore them and rebuild the root from power-on, comparing the key hash.
